How JVTO private tour booking works: website-only booking, payments, changes, and Lifetime Package Credit.

1. **Choose your route and dates** — browse packages on the website and select your date, origin (Surabaya or Bali), group size, and route. 2. **Review price and add-ons** — the website shows your total, inclusions, and any add-ons before you commit. 3. **Accept the terms and pay** — accept the Terms & Cancellation Policy and pay; a 20% deposit confirms the booking (up to 100% if Day 1 is within 14 days). 4. **Receive your Official E-Voucher** — a PDF is issued after deposit payment. This is your booking reference and includes your full trip details and pre-trip guide. 5. **Access My Booking Portal** — post-payment, you gain access to your personal booking dashboard using your lead traveller email.

Tumpak Sewu canyon descent logistics: trail sequence, wet-rock safety, best season, monsoon warnings, and essential equipment.
The viewpoint at the rim takes 10 minutes. The descent into the canyon takes around 90 minutes if taken slowly. Guests should expect wet stone, water spray, and river crossings.
The thousand-stream waterfall is reached by a steep, slippery descent through a jungle ravine - visually unmatched and physically demanding.

During and immediately after heavy rain, the canyon floor can flood rapidly. JVTO guides cancel descent when rainfall or water conditions make the canyon unsafe, then substitute an alternative such as Goa Tetes or reschedule where possible.
